label: SC-6
title: Resource Availability

statement.prose: Protect the availability of resources by allocating {{ insert: param, sc-06_odp.01 }} by {{ insert: param, sc-06_odp.02 }}.

guidance: Priority protection prevents lower-priority processes from delaying or interfering with the system that services higher-priority processes. Quotas prevent users or processes from obtaining more than predetermined amounts of resources.

params.label: resources
guidelines: resources to be allocated to protect the availability of resources are defined;

params.label: controls
guidelines: controls to protect the availability of resources are defined (if selected);
